```{r}
#| include: false
reticulate::py_require("polars")
```

```{python}
import polars as pl

PATH_BASICS     = "title.basics0.tsv"
PATH_RATINGS    = "title.ratings.tsv"
PATH_PRINCIPALS = "title.principals0.tsv"

def le_tsv(path):
    return pl.scan_csv(
        path,
        separator="\t",
        null_values=["\\N"],   
        quote_char=None,       
        infer_schema_length=10_000,)

basics     = le_tsv(PATH_BASICS)
ratings    = le_tsv(PATH_RATINGS)
principals = le_tsv(PATH_PRINCIPALS)
```

```{python}
filmes = (
    basics
    .filter(pl.col("titleType") == "movie")
    .join(ratings, on="tconst", how="inner")
)
```

## Questão 1

```{python}
top5 = (
    filmes
    .select("tconst", "primaryTitle", "startYear", "averageRating", "numVotes")
    .sort(["averageRating", "numVotes"], descending=[True, True])
    .head(5)
    .collect(engine="streaming")
)

top5
```

## Questão 2
```{python}
generos = (
    filmes
    .filter(pl.col("averageRating") > 8)
    .select("tconst", "genres")
    .drop_nulls("genres")
    .with_columns(pl.col("genres").str.split(","))
    .explode("genres")
    .group_by("genres")
    .agg(pl.len().alias("n_filmes"))
    .sort("n_filmes", descending=True)
    .collect(engine="streaming")
)

generos.head(10)
```

```{python}
generos.head(1)
```

## Questão 3

```{python}
filmes_bons = (
    filmes
    .filter(pl.col("averageRating") > 7.5)
    .select("tconst")
)

top3_atores = (
    principals
    .filter(pl.col("category").is_in(["actor", "actress"]))
    .select("tconst", "nconst", "category")
    .join(filmes_bons, on="tconst", how="inner")
    .group_by("nconst")
    .agg(pl.col("tconst").n_unique().alias("n_filmes"))
    .sort("n_filmes", descending=True)
    .head(3)
    .collect(engine="streaming")
)

top3_atores
```
